title: USB Audio Out (MAIN, CUE)
author: irpina
description: The Octatrack as a 4-channel USB audio input (UAC2, 44.1 kHz, 24-bit) on its own USB port, as a function of usb-ot: MAIN on channels 1-2 and CUE on 3-4 at high speed, MAIN at full speed. It combines with USB MIDI. One of mods/usb-audio-ot's five layouts.
